notes.title: Scream Fest Is Live! Huge Discounts On Halloween-y Games!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The Steam Scream Fest is live right now, and given that I've made tons of Halloween-related games, it only made sense to participate! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276810/The_Outbound_Ghost/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/

3 of the games I've previously made are discounted, The Outbound Ghost, Soul Stalker, and Wanted Shadows. However, not only can you get them individually, but you can also [b]get them all in a bundle[/b] for  for just $16.22 instead of the usual $27. If you already own any of the games as well, no worries, because you can still get the discount for the other games you don't yet own! You can find the bundle below.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46376/Radical_Halloween/

Also, we recently announced The Outbound Ghost: Reborn, a new game in the universe of The Outbound Ghost and Soul Stalker, and it will of course be included in next year's Steam Scream Fest as a released game! What's even better is that the game will be [b]COMPLETELY FREE[/b] if you already own the first The Outbound Ghost game before the sequel's release! Wishlist it below to be notified of when it comes out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884520/The_Outbound_Ghost_Reborn/

Anyways, that's it for this update, and I'll be announcing the next update for The Outbound Ghost very soon.

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: New Outbound Universe Game OUT NOW! Discount for owners of The Outbound Ghost!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're hard at work with finalising the [b]first The Outbound Ghost update post-lawsuit[/b], and I'm happy to announce that it will be coming to Steam [b]within the next 2 weeks[/b]! Development on The Outbound Ghost: Reborn is also going super well, and I can't wait to show you all the drastic improvements that we've been making from the first game :)

The main reason I'm making this post however, is because the another game of ours is[b] out RIGHT NOW[/b]!

It's called SOUL STALKER, and not only is the game's universe is the same as that of The Outbound Ghost, it's also a [b]direct prequel set in the distant past[/b]! If you played through the original game's entire story, then some SOUL STALKER's NPC interactions might give some [b]additional context about what exists beyond the town Outbound[/b].

Gameplay-wise, it's a [b]bullet heaven roguelike[/b], so think gameplay similar to Vampire Survivors/Brotato with some Hades and Slay the Spire sprinkled in.

If this sounds like a fun game to you, you can get it in the link below! It's on a [b]20% launch discount [/b]right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

Also, [b]if you already own The Outbound Ghost[/b], then you'll get an [b]additional 15% discount[/b] by buying the game through the bundle below! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39198/Outbound_Collection/

Since the game's [b]base price is just $4.99[/b], you'll get tons of bang for your buck, and I hope you enjoy it! Anyways, that's it for this update, and I'll be in touch with you soon regarding The Outbound Ghost: Reborn's development!

- Conrad, Lead Developer
